newsitem.title: USA: El Chico discloses that offer was rejected.
newsitem.headline: El Chico discloses that offer was rejected.

text.p: El Chico Restaurants Inc said on Friday that it has rejected an proposal to acquire the company for an amount exceeding the market price of the stock.

GHS Management, a leading shareholder, objected to the board's decision, El Chico said. El Chico said it issued the statement after it received a letter from GHS that was part of a 13D filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
El Chico said its board believes that the best course of action is for the company to continue on its current operating strategy.
The board had not disclosed the offer and feels that it would not be practical or beneficial to to disclose every expression of interest that the board determines not to pursue, El Chico said.
The board is willing to consider any fair and serious offer to acquire the company, El Chico said.
